name: Seki Yayoi
source:
A mother of two. She works at a supermarket. She became close with the protagonist after taking on the role of mentor when he started working part-time at the same place a few years ago.

Upon learning that he was working part-time to earn money for college tuition, she began cheering him on.

As time passed, the protagonist passed his entrance exams and confessed his feelings to her, and the result was...
